title: Introducing Apple Watch Series 12, with the all-new Health Sensing System
title_zh: 苹果手表系列12，搭载全新健康感知系统

paragraphs.en: Apple Watch Series 12 delivers the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable, higher-frequency heart rate and heart rate variability sensing, and a readiness score. CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced Apple Watch Series 12 , engineered with advanced health sensors and all-new Apple silicon to deliver the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable, 1 and advanced health and fitness features. With the new Health Sensing System and S11 chip, Apple Watch Series 12 delivers higher-frequency heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV) measurements, which power an enhanced suite of health and fitness features including a new readiness score. A redesigned Health app on iPhone arrives later this year, including a new Longevity tab with a Health Age feature showing how metrics are tracking relative to a user’s age. In addition to powering the Health Sensing System, the S11 chip — Apple’s most powerful wearable chip — also enables new Audio Intelligence features arriving later this year, to help users remember key moments from their conversations and stay alert to important sounds, built with privacy, security, and accessibility innovations at the core. 2 With watchOS 27, Apple Intelligence powers Siri AI on Apple Watch, bringing personal context understanding and broad world knowledge to the wrist. These features add to the many ways Apple Watch already helps users stay active, better understand their health, and get help when they need it, with advanced workout tracking, sleep tracking, heart health notifications, the ECG app, 3 sleep apnea notifications, 4 Fall Detection, Emergency SOS, 5 and more. It is also available in a stunning ceramic material, in pearl white and night blue. Aluminum models now feature Ceramic Shield 2, which is tougher than any smartwatch glass and 60 percent tougher than the Ion-X of previous aluminum models. 7 Apple Watch Series 12 is available to pre-order today, with availability beginning Friday, September 18. “Apple Watch Series 12 is the most advanced health and fitness companion we’ve ever created,” said Kaiann Drance, Apple’s vice president of Worldwide Apple Watch Product Marketing. “With our new Health Sensing System and S11 chip, Apple Watch Series 12 gives you meaningful insights, like readiness, so you can better understand how to take on your day and care for your health, plus intelligence features that make everyday life easier. And it’s all wrapped in a beautifully thin, light design you’ll love wearing all day and night.” The Most Accurate Heart Rate Sensing in a Wearable Apple Watch Series 12 is re-architected to provide continuous high-fidelity health monitoring using the Health Sensing System, featuring new optical and electrical heart sensors. Using this system and the S11 chip, Apple Watch Series 12 offers the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable. A scientifically rigorous study on a diverse population of over 1,000 participants compared the new heart rate sensing accuracy on Apple Watch against leading wearables, resulting in Apple Watch showing the highest accuracy across devices. With larger, power-efficient green LEDs on the optical heart sensor, Apple Watch Series 12 now measures heart rate every five seconds, all day long. This continuous, passive measurement delivers deeper insight into a user’s fitness and physiological state while making Exercise and Move Activity rings even more accurate.

Apple Watch Series 12 features larger, power-efficient green LEDs on the optical heart sensor, measuring heart rate every five seconds and delivering deeper insight into a user’s fitness and physiological state. HRV, a key indicator of stress and recovery, is now measured up to 24 times more often and available to view in a new section of the Heart Rate app. Apple Watch provides two separate variants of HRV for better understanding of a user’s health status. Recovery HRV is best for identifying daily signals of stress and recovery, while overall HRV is best for insights into a user’s broader health, including cardiovascular health. Higher variability is generally associated with better overall recovery, while a lower variability value is an indicator of stress. Overnight vitals now includes recovery HRV measurements analyzed against a user’s personal baseline, providing a more complete view of their health status. 8 A new daytime vitals view lets users toggle between overnight and daytime metrics, and can potentially spot shifts in their metrics before they show up overnight. This helps a user decide how to take on their day, whether they’re headed into a workday or tackling their training plan.

sents.en: Apple Watch provides two separate variants of HRV for better understanding of a user’s health status.
sents.zh: Apple Watch 提供两种独立的 HRV 版本，以便用户更好地理解自身健康状况。

sents.en: Recovery HRV is best for identifying daily signals of stress and recovery, while overall HRV is best for insights into a user’s broader health, including cardiovascular health.
sents.zh: 恢复期 HRV 最适合识别日常的压力和恢复信号，而整体 HRV 则更适合深入了解用户的全面健康情况，包括心血管健康。

sents.en: Higher variability is generally associated with better overall recovery, while a lower variability value is an indicator of stress.
sents.zh: 较高的变异性通常与更好的整体恢复能力相关，而较低的变异性值则是压力的标志。

sents.en: Overnight vitals now includes recovery HRV measurements analyzed against a user’s personal baseline, providing a more complete view of their health status. 8 A new daytime vitals view lets users toggle between overnight and daytime metrics, and can potentially spot shifts in their metrics before they show up overnight.
sents.zh: “夜间体征”功能现在包含恢复期 HRV 测量数据，并与用户的个人基准数据进行对比分析，从而提供更全面的健康状况视图。8 全新的“日间体征”视图让用户可以在夜间和日间指标之间切换，并可能在这些变化反映到夜间数据之前发现异常波动。

paragraphs.en: previous next Audio Intelligence: A New Way to Stay More Present and Engaged Throughout the Day Since Apple Watch is always on a user’s wrist, it is the perfect device to help users stay alert to important sounds and stay present and engaged in conversations throughout the day. With the built-in microphone, the power of the S11 chip, the latest Apple Intelligence models on iPhone, and Private Cloud Compute, Apple Watch Series 12 offers a brand-new class of Apple Intelligence features. Audio Intelligence helps users stay aware of the world around them, catch what they missed, and remember key moments — with user control, privacy, security, and accessibility at the center of its design. Audio Intelligence features include: Sound Recognition , which comes to Apple Watch to alert users who are deaf or hard of hearing of important sounds, even when their iPhone isn’t with them. This feature listens for sounds like sirens, alarms, doorbells, or a baby crying, and uses on-device intelligence to notify users when they’re detected. Live Rewind , which can help users recall what was just said in conversation. A double press of the Digital Crown shows the previous 15 seconds of a conversation as a text snippet, so the user can catch something they may have missed or are less familiar with. Users can ask Siri about the content of the text or save it to the Siri app to revisit later. Siri Recap , which can create high-level summaries of conversations that users can review later to jog their memory. When Siri Recap is turned on, after a conversation, Apple Intelligence automatically generates a title and key points in the new Siri app, allowing users to be more present and engaged in the moment. Shazam , which instantly detects the music playing around the user and automatically displays the song title and artist’s name on the Music Recognition widget in the Smart Stack, easily glanceable on the wrist. Apple Watch Series 12 shows the Sound Recognition feature with a message about a doorbell being detected. Apple Watch Series 12 shows the Live Rewind feature with a message that says, “Make sure you stay to the left after the trail marker, unless you want to run a longer loop.” Apple Watch Series 12 and iPhone 18 Pro show the Siri Recap feature with an outline of a personal training routine. Apple Watch Series 12 shows Shazam with the song “Honeybee” by Olivia Rodrigo detected.

paragraphs.en: A brand-new class of Apple Intelligence features comes to Apple Watch Series 12, including Sound Recognition, which alerts users who are deaf or hard of hearing of important sounds — like sirens, alarms, doorbells, or a baby crying — even when their iPhone isn’t with them. Live Rewind can help users recall what was just said in conversation, so they can catch something they may have missed. Siri Recap creates high-level summaries of conversations that users can review later to jog their memory. When Siri Recap is turned on, after a conversation, Apple Intelligence automatically generates a title and key points in the new Siri app, allowing users to be more present and engaged in the moment. Shazam instantly detects the music playing around the user and automatically displays the song title and artist’s name on the Music Recognition widget in the Smart Stack. previous next Privacy by Design Audio Intelligence features are private by design, combining hardware, software, and services to protect user privacy in a way that only Apple can. These features do not create or store audio recordings, and raw audio used for processing is completely inaccessible to the operating systems, apps, the user, or Apple. This is because the S11 chip on Apple Watch Series 12 includes Secure Exclave, a dedicated hardware-isolated compartment that processes audio in complete isolation from the rest of the system, then immediately deletes it. Users are in control and can choose whether to opt in to each Audio Intelligence feature. They can decide exactly where and when Siri Recap takes notes, and can turn Siri Recap on or off at any time, right from Control Center. By design, Audio Intelligence features do not identify and attribute speakers, to protect the privacy of both the user and those around them. Siri Recap produces a brief, high-level summary of conversations — not a transcript — and is designed to exclude sensitive information like financial information or government-assigned identifiers. Live Rewind plays an audible chime when it is being used, even if Apple Watch is on silent, and shows a full-display animation and microphone indicator so people nearby can hear and see that the feature has been activated. Live Rewind text snippets and Siri Recap summaries are end-to-end encrypted in the Siri app with iCloud syncing, and are not accessible even by Apple. paragraphs.en: Introducing Apple Watch Series 12, with the all-new Health Sensing System
paragraphs.zh: 隆重推出 Apple Watch Series 12，搭载全新健康感知系统

paragraphs.en: Apple Watch Series 12 offers the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable, higher-frequency heart rate and HRV sensing, a readiness score, and Audio Intelligence features built with privacy at the core
paragraphs.zh: Apple Watch Series 12 提供了可穿戴设备中最精准的心率感应功能，包括更高频率的心率和 HRV（心率变异性）感应、准备度评分以及以隐私为核心设计的音频智能功能。

paragraphs.en: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced Apple Watch Series 12 , engineered with advanced health sensors and all-new Apple silicon to deliver the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable, 1 and advanced health and fitness features.
paragraphs.zh: 加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺——苹果公司今日推出了 Apple Watch Series 12。该设备采用先进的健康传感器和全新的 Apple 芯片打造，可在可穿戴设备中提供最为精准的心率监测功能¹，并具备更强大的健康与健身功能。

paragraphs.en: With the new Health Sensing System and S11 chip, Apple Watch Series 12 delivers higher-frequency heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV) measurements, which power an enhanced suite of health and fitness features including a new readiness score. A redesigned Health app on iPhone arrives later this year, including a new Longevity tab with a Health Age feature showing how metrics are tracking relative to a user’s age. In addition to powering the Health Sensing System, the S11 chip — Apple’s most powerful wearable chip — also enables new Audio Intelligence features arriving later this year, to help users remember key moments from their conversations and stay alert to important sounds, built with privacy, security, and accessibility innovations at the core. 2 With watchOS 27, Apple Intelligence powers Siri AI on Apple Watch, bringing personal context understanding and broad world knowledge to the wrist.
paragraphs.zh: 借助全新的健康传感系统和 S11 芯片，Apple Watch Series 12 能够以更高频率测量心率和心率变异性（HRV），从而支持一系列增强型健康与健身功能，包括一项全新的准备度评分。 iPhone 上的全新设计版“健康”应用将于今年晚些时候推出，其中包含一个名为“长寿”的新选项卡，内含“健康年龄”功能，可显示各项指标相对于用户实际年龄的追踪情况。 S11 芯片不仅是健康传感系统的动力核心——它也是苹果迄今性能最强的可穿戴设备芯片——还将在今年晚些时候启用全新的音频智能功能，帮助用户记住对话中的关键瞬间，并敏锐捕捉重要声音；这些功能以隐私、安全和无障碍创新为核心进行设计。2 借助 watchOS 27，Apple Intelligence 将为 Apple Watch 上的 Siri AI 提供动力，将个人情境理解与广泛的世界知识带到用户腕间。

paragraphs.en: The Most Accurate Heart Rate Sensing in a Wearable
paragraphs.zh: 可穿戴设备中最精准的心率感应技术

paragraphs.en: Apple Watch Series 12 is re-architected to provide continuous high-fidelity health monitoring using the Health Sensing System, featuring new optical and electrical heart sensors. Using this system and the S11 chip, Apple Watch Series 12 offers the most accurate heart rate sensing in a wearable. A scientifically rigorous study on a diverse population of over 1,000 participants compared the new heart rate sensing accuracy on Apple Watch against leading wearables, resulting in Apple Watch showing the highest accuracy across devices.
paragraphs.zh: Apple Watch Series 12 经过重新架构，借助健康传感系统可提供持续的高保真健康监测，并配备了全新的光学和电学心率传感器。 通过该系统和 S11 芯片，Apple Watch Series 12 实现了可穿戴设备中最精准的心率检测。 一项针对超过 1,000 名多样化参与者的严谨科学研究，将 Apple Watch 的新心率检测精度与主流可穿戴设备进行了比较，结果显示 Apple Watch 在所有设备中准确率最高。

sents.en: A scientifically rigorous study on a diverse population of over 1,000 participants compared the new heart rate sensing accuracy on Apple Watch against leading wearables, resulting in Apple Watch showing the highest accuracy across devices.

paragraphs.en: With larger, power-efficient green LEDs on the optical heart sensor, Apple Watch Series 12 now measures heart rate every five seconds, all day long. This continuous, passive measurement delivers deeper insight into a user’s fitness and physiological state while making Exercise and Move Activity rings even more accurate. Users can view their real-time heart rate at a glance throughout their day on a new heart rate watch face complication.
paragraphs.zh: 光学心率传感器采用了更大且能效更高的绿色 LED，因此 Apple Watch Series 12 现在能够全天每五秒测量一次心率。 这种持续、无感的测量方式能更深入地了解用户的健身状况和生理状态，同时让锻炼与活动环的准确性进一步提升。 用户可以在全新的心率表盘小工具中，随时查看自己全天的实时心率。

paragraphs.en: HRV, a key indicator of stress and recovery, is now measured up to 24 times more often and available to view in a new section of the Heart Rate app. Apple Watch provides two separate variants of HRV for better understanding of a user’s health status. Recovery HRV is best for identifying daily signals of stress and recovery, while overall HRV is best for insights into a user’s broader health, including cardiovascular health. Higher variability is generally associated with better overall recovery, while a lower variability value is an indicator of stress.
paragraphs.zh: HRV 是衡量压力与恢复状态的关键指标，如今其测量频率最高可达原来的 24 倍，并且可在“心率”应用的新版块中查看。 Apple Watch 提供两种独立的 HRV 版本，以便用户更清晰地了解自身健康状况。 恢复期 HRV 最适合识别日常的压力与恢复信号，而整体 HRV 则更适合深入了解用户的全面健康状态，包括心血管健康。 较高的变异性通常意味着更好的整体恢复状态，而较低的变异性值则是压力的标志。

paragraphs.en: Overnight vitals now includes recovery HRV measurements analyzed against a user’s personal baseline, providing a more complete view of their health status. 8 A new daytime vitals view lets users toggle between overnight and daytime metrics, and can potentially spot shifts in their metrics before they show up overnight.
paragraphs.zh: 夜间健康指标现已包含恢复期 HRV 测量值，并与用户的个人基准数据进行对比分析，从而提供更全面的健康状况视图。8 全新的日间健康指标视图允许用户在夜间和日间指标之间切换，并可能在其夜间指标出现异常之前，就发现指标的变化。

paragraphs.en: Readiness: A Daily Read on the Body’s Capacity
paragraphs.zh: 准备状态：关于身体能力的每日阅读

paragraphs.en: Apple Watch Series 12 introduces readiness, a new feature that analyzes a user’s recent activity, training load, vitals, and sleep score to offer insight into their capacity for the day ahead. Readiness provides a single 0-10 score with a clear, actionable recommendation: Recover, Pace Yourself, Ready, or Go For It. This helps a user decide how to take on their day, whether they’re headed into a workday or tackling their training plan.
paragraphs.zh: Apple Watch Series 12 推出了“准备度”这一新功能，该功能会分析用户的近期活动、训练负荷、生理指标和睡眠评分，从而提供关于其应对当天挑战能力的洞察。 “准备度”会给出一个从 0 到 10 的单一评分，并附带清晰且可操作的建议：恢复、控制节奏、准备就绪或全力以赴。 这有助于用户决定如何安排自己的一天，无论他们即将开始工作日还是执行训练计划。

paragraphs.en: Longer Workout Battery Life and Faster Charging
paragraphs.zh: 更长的运动续航与更快的充电速度

paragraphs.zh: Apple Watch Series 12 依然可提供长达 24 小时的日常续航时间 9，如今在户外锻炼时也能提供长达 10 小时的续航时间——比上一代产品提升了 25%。10

paragraphs.en: The Most Accurate Step Tracking of Any Smartwatch
paragraphs.zh: 任何智能手表中最精准的步数追踪

paragraphs.en: The pedometer model has been completely redesigned with new machine learning algorithms to provide more accurate distance measurements during indoor walk or run workouts, and the S11 chip allows for more accurate step counts all day. As a result, Apple Watch Series 12 now offers the most accurate step tracking of any smartwatch. 12 The S11 chip also enables the brand-new Steps complication, so users can track their steps in real time, right from their watch face.
paragraphs.zh: 计步器模型已采用全新的机器学习算法进行彻底重新设计，以便在室内步行或跑步锻炼时提供更精确的距离测量；S11 芯片则能实现全天更精准的步数统计。 因此，Apple Watch Series 12 如今提供了所有智能手表中最精确的步数追踪功能。12 S11 芯片还支持全新的“步数”复杂功能，让用户可以直接在表盘上实时追踪自己的步数。

paragraphs.en: A Redesigned Health App Offers a Holistic View of Long‑Term Health
paragraphs.zh: 重新设计的健康应用提供全面长期的健康视角

paragraphs.en: The Health app on iPhone serves as a central and secure location for a user’s health and fitness information, uniquely positioning it to provide a better understanding of a user’s health. The Health app has been redesigned to dynamically respond to a user’s data using Apple Intelligence, 13 with a new Insights tab that surfaces timely health information and a new Longevity tab that analyzes a user’s longitudinal health data for deeper insights. The Longevity tab includes Health Age, an Apple Watch feature that shows users how certain metrics are tracking relative to their actual age.
paragraphs.zh: iPhone 上的“健康”App 是一个集中且安全的位置，用于存储用户的健康和健身信息，这使其能够更清晰地帮助用户了解自身健康状况。 “健康”App 经过重新设计，可借助 Apple Intelligence 动态响应用户的数据，13 并新增了一个“洞察”选项卡，用于呈现及时的健康信息，以及一个“长寿”选项卡，用于分析用户的长期健康数据以获取更深入的了解。 “长寿”选项卡包含“健康年龄”功能，这是 Apple Watch 的一项功能，可让用户了解某些指标相对于其实际年龄的变化情况。

paragraphs.en: Audio Intelligence: A New Way to Stay More Present and Engaged Throughout the Day
paragraphs.zh: 音频智能：全天保持专注与投入的新方式

paragraphs.en: Since Apple Watch is always on a user’s wrist, it is the perfect device to help users stay alert to important sounds and stay present and engaged in conversations throughout the day. With the built-in microphone, the power of the S11 chip, the latest Apple Intelligence models on iPhone, and Private Cloud Compute, Apple Watch Series 12 offers a brand-new class of Apple Intelligence features. Audio Intelligence helps users stay aware of the world around them, catch what they missed, and remember key moments — with user control, privacy, security, and accessibility at the center of its design.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 Apple Watch 始终佩戴在用户的腕间，因此它是帮助用户随时留意重要声音、全天保持专注并积极参与对话的理想设备。 凭借内置麦克风、S11 芯片的强大性能、iPhone 上的最新 Apple Intelligence 模型以及私有云计算功能，Apple Watch Series 12 带来了全新类别的 Apple Intelligence 功能。 音频智能功能可帮助用户感知周围的世界、捕捉错过的内容并记住关键时刻——其设计始终以用户控制、隐私、安全和无障碍为核心。

sents.en: Since Apple Watch is always on a user’s wrist, it is the perfect device to help users stay alert to important sounds and stay present and engaged in conversations throughout the day.
sents.zh: 由于 Apple Watch 始终佩戴在用户的腕间，因此它是帮助用户随时留意重要声音、全天保持专注并积极参与对话的理想设备。

sents.en: With the built-in microphone, the power of the S11 chip, the latest Apple Intelligence models on iPhone, and Private Cloud Compute, Apple Watch Series 12 offers a brand-new class of Apple Intelligence features.
sents.zh: 凭借内置麦克风、S11 芯片的强大性能、iPhone 上的最新 Apple Intelligence 模型以及私有云计算功能，Apple Watch Series 12 带来了全新类别的 Apple Intelligence 功能。

sents.en: Audio Intelligence helps users stay aware of the world around them, catch what they missed, and remember key moments — with user control, privacy, security, and accessibility at the center of its design.
sents.zh: 音频智能功能可帮助用户感知周围的世界、捕捉错过的内容并记住关键时刻——其设计始终以用户控制、隐私、安全和无障碍为核心。

paragraphs.en: Audio Intelligence features are private by design, combining hardware, software, and services to protect user privacy in a way that only Apple can. These features do not create or store audio recordings, and raw audio used for processing is completely inaccessible to the operating systems, apps, the user, or Apple. This is because the S11 chip on Apple Watch Series 12 includes Secure Exclave, a dedicated hardware-isolated compartment that processes audio in complete isolation from the rest of the system, then immediately deletes it.
paragraphs.zh: 音频智能功能在架构上即具备隐私保护特性，通过结合硬件、软件和服务，以唯有 Apple 才能实现的方式保护用户隐私。 这些功能不会创建或存储音频录音，且用于处理的原始音频对操作系统、应用程序、用户或 Apple 均完全不可访问。 这是因为 Apple Watch Series 12 上的 S11 芯片集成了安全飞地（Secure Exclave）——一个硬件隔离的专用区域，可在与系统其余部分完全隔离的状态下处理音频，随后立即将其删除。

sents.en: Audio Intelligence features are private by design, combining hardware, software, and services to protect user privacy in a way that only Apple can.
sents.zh: 音频智能功能在架构上即具备隐私保护特性，通过结合硬件、软件和服务，以唯有 Apple 才能实现的方式保护用户隐私。

sents.en: These features do not create or store audio recordings, and raw audio used for processing is completely inaccessible to the operating systems, apps, the user, or Apple.
sents.zh: 这些功能不会创建或存储音频录音，且用于处理的原始音频对操作系统、应用程序、用户或 Apple 均完全不可访问。

sents.en: This is because the S11 chip on Apple Watch Series 12 includes Secure Exclave, a dedicated hardware-isolated compartment that processes audio in complete isolation from the rest of the system, then immediately deletes it.
sents.zh: 这是因为 Apple Watch Series 12 上的 S11 芯片集成了安全飞地（Secure Exclave）——一个硬件隔离的专用区域，可在与系统其余部分完全隔离的状态下处理音频，随后立即将其删除。

paragraphs.en: Users are in control and can choose whether to opt in to each Audio Intelligence feature. They can decide exactly where and when Siri Recap takes notes, and can turn Siri Recap on or off at any time, right from Control Center.
paragraphs.zh: 用户拥有控制权，可以选择是否启用每一项音频智能功能。 用户可以决定 Siri 摘要具体在何时何地记录笔记，并且可以随时直接从控制中心开启或关闭 Siri 摘要。

sents.en: Users are in control and can choose whether to opt in to each Audio Intelligence feature.
sents.zh: 用户拥有控制权，可以选择是否启用每一项音频智能功能。

sents.en: They can decide exactly where and when Siri Recap takes notes, and can turn Siri Recap on or off at any time, right from Control Center.
sents.zh: 用户可以决定 Siri 摘要具体在何时何地记录笔记，并且可以随时直接从控制中心开启或关闭 Siri 摘要。

paragraphs.en: By design, Audio Intelligence features do not identify and attribute speakers, to protect the privacy of both the user and those around them. Siri Recap produces a brief, high-level summary of conversations — not a transcript — and is designed to exclude sensitive information like financial information or government-assigned identifiers. Live Rewind plays an audible chime when it is being used, even if Apple Watch is on silent, and shows a full-display animation and microphone indicator so people nearby can hear and see that the feature has been activated.
paragraphs.zh: 音频智能功能经过精心设计，不会识别或标注说话者，以保护用户及其周围人的隐私。 Siri 摘要会生成对话的简要高层次总结——而非逐字记录——并且设计为排除财务信息或政府分配的身份标识等敏感信息。 实时回看功能在使用时会发出可听见的提示音，即使 Apple Watch 处于静音模式也是如此，同时还会显示全屏动画和麦克风指示器，让附近的人能够听到并看到该功能已被激活。

sents.en: By design, Audio Intelligence features do not identify and attribute speakers, to protect the privacy of both the user and those around them.
sents.zh: 音频智能功能经过精心设计，不会识别或标注说话者，以保护用户及其周围人的隐私。

sents.en: Siri Recap produces a brief, high-level summary of conversations — not a transcript — and is designed to exclude sensitive information like financial information or government-assigned identifiers.
sents.zh: Siri 摘要会生成对话的简要高层次总结——而非逐字记录——并且设计为排除财务信息或政府分配的身份标识等敏感信息。

sents.en: Live Rewind plays an audible chime when it is being used, even if Apple Watch is on silent, and shows a full-display animation and microphone indicator so people nearby can hear and see that the feature has been activated.

paragraphs.en: Live Rewind text snippets and Siri Recap summaries are end-to-end encrypted in the Siri app with iCloud syncing, and are not accessible even by Apple. Read more about how Audio Intelligence protects privacy. Siri Recap and Live Rewind arrive in beta later this year.
paragraphs.zh: Live Rewind 文本片段和 Siri Recap 摘要在 Siri 应用中采用端到端加密，并通过 iCloud 同步，即便是苹果公司也无法访问。 阅读更多有关 Audio Intelligence 如何保护隐私的信息。 Siri Recap 和 Live Rewind 将于今年晚些时候推出测试版。

sents.en: Read more about how Audio Intelligence protects privacy.
sents.zh: 阅读更多有关 Audio Intelligence 如何保护隐私的信息。

sents.en: Siri Recap and Live Rewind arrive in beta later this year.
sents.zh: Siri Recap 和 Live Rewind 将于今年晚些时候推出测试版。

paragraphs.en: Siri AI Brings Personal Context Understanding and Broad World Knowledge
paragraphs.zh: Siri AI 实现个性化上下文理解与广泛世界知识

paragraphs.en: With watchOS 27, Apple Watch Series 12 supports Siri AI, an entirely new version of Siri powered by Apple Intelligence. The new Siri app lets users continue conversations on the go and tap into Apple Intelligence capabilities — like personal context understanding and broad world knowledge — making Apple Watch an even more intelligent companion on the wrist. A new Siri Modular watch face makes it even easier to access Siri throughout the day. 14
paragraphs.zh: 借助 watchOS 27，Apple Watch Series 12 支持 Siri AI，这是由 Apple Intelligence 驱动的全新版本 Siri。 全新的 Siri 应用让用户可以在移动中继续对话，并利用 Apple Intelligence 的能力——例如个人上下文理解与广泛的世界知识——使 Apple Watch 成为腕间更智能的伙伴。 全新的 Siri 模块化表盘让全天候使用 Siri 变得更加轻松。14

paragraphs.en: Apple Watch Series 12 is available in 42mm and 46mm sizes. Aluminum finishes include beautiful new dark bronze, black, and light gold options, plus the popular space gray finish. Titanium finishes include a rich new radiant gold color, alongside natural titanium.
paragraphs.zh: Apple Watch Series 12 提供 42 毫米和 46 毫米两种尺寸。 铝制表壳可选配全新精美的深青铜色、黑色和浅金色，以及广受欢迎的太空灰色。 钛金属表壳则包含全新浓郁的耀目金色，以及自然钛金属配色。

sents.zh: Apple Watch Series 12 提供 42 毫米和 46 毫米两种尺寸。

paragraphs.en: Apple Watch Series 12 and the Environment
paragraphs.zh: Apple Watch Series 12 与环境

paragraphs.en: Apple Watch Series 12 was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 40 percent recycled material overall, 20 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the aluminum case and 100 percent recycled titanium in the 3D-printed titanium case. All of the electricity used to manufacture Apple Watch Series 12 is sourced from renewable energy, like wind and solar, across the supply chain, 21 and Apple has also invested in enough renewable energy around the world to match the electricity customers use to charge their Apple Watch. Like all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 22 and can be easily recycled at home.
paragraphs.zh: Apple Watch Series 12 的设计充分考虑了环境因素，并推动了苹果实现其宏伟计划的进程——即到 2030 年在其整个业务足迹中实现碳中和。 该产品整体采用 40% 的回收材料制成，其中包括铝制表壳中 100% 回收的铝以及 3D 打印钛制表壳中 100% 回收的钛，合计占比 20%。 Apple Watch Series 12 制造过程中使用的全部电力均来自供应链中的可再生能源（如风能和太阳能），此外，苹果还投资了全球范围内足以匹配客户为其 Apple Watch 充电所用电量的可再生能源。 与所有苹果产品一样，其纸质包装完全由纤维制成，并可在家庭环境中轻松回收。
